EXT. ORCHARD - MORNING

Mist hangs between the apple trees. ELSIE (60s) walks the rows with a basket on her hip.

                    ELSIE
          These won't last the week.
          Not with this frost coming.

                    THEO
          Then we pick them today.
          All of them.

INT. ORCHARD HOUSE - KITCHEN - DAY

Baskets cover every surface of the small kitchen, apples spilling onto the floor.

                    ELSIE
          Your grandfather planted these.
          Every single one.
